method.note: Grouping uses MobileNetV2 cosine distance with average linkage clustering at threshold 0.20, chosen after a leakage sweep (0.15 left about 58% of val/test images with a train image closer than 0.14; 0.20 leaves about 10% combined, about 4% in test). Grouping is approximate; some repeated rooms may still straddle splits. Do not recompute on Kaggle/Colab -- read this file.
